Welcome
I would like to warmly welcome you to St Andrew’s C of E Primary School.
Everything we do at St Andrew's has our pupils at the heart of it. Our curriculum offers the right balance of academic and practical, as well as a ‘character curriculum’ that enables everyone to develop age appropriate virtues, in preparation for our modern society’s needs. As a Church school we encourage an understanding of the meaning and significance of faith, and promote Christian values. Our extensive school grounds have led us to teach outdoors whenever we are able, and we also provide all pupils with opportunities to develop their competitive sports skills.

Young Explorers @ Cobham run a pre-school on-site at St Andrew’s School. The Team has many years’ experience in working and running pre-schools and clubs, and are passionate about childcare. They have experience in running breakfast clubs and after-school clubs for infant/junior pupils.
The Breakfast and After School Club service will only be available to St Andrew’s school children.
The Team at Young Explorers @ Cobham are always looking at ways to improve and enhance their service while at the same time providing a stable setting for the children in their care. They ask that you come and talk to them if you have any concerns or comments, tell them what is good, or what is not so good. The most important thing for us is that your child is happy to attend their Clubs, and their service can satisfy your needs.
What will the children have to eat?
Mornings: The menu will vary daily, but may include: crumpets, muffins, cereal, bagels, pancakes, toast, yogurts, fruit and croissants. Cereals including porridge.
After School Club includes a light tea: filled wraps, filled sandwiches, filled pitta bread, filled bagels, toasted sandwiches, fruit, yogurts, etc)
What do I need to do?
You need to fill in an application form if you wish to use the service. Forms are available from the school office or can be downloaded from this page.
If you do not currently use the service, but may be interested in starting, please do drop in, they can introduce themselves and lead you through the process of registering (subject to available places).

pageCache.text:
Curriculum Aims & Overview
Feeling gratitude enhances mental health and wellbeing, leading to better conflict resolution, empathy and personal growth skills in and outside of school.
Cultivate respect of self, community and the wider world. Christian and British Values are actively chosen creating self- disciplined global citizens.
Develop a positive sense of self and individual identity underpinned by an inherent understanding of the rule of law.
Ensure all children demonstrate effort and independence, doing their best and persevering: bounce-back-ability!
Our curriculum is based on the National Curriculum which can be found via the link https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/national-curriculum-in-england-primary-curriculum.
Our curriculum continues to develop to ensure that we meet the requirements of the National Curriculum and beyond in providing our pupils with a knowledge-rich education to ensure their success as they move into KS3.
At St Andrew’s we offer a broad, balanced and academically rigorous curriculum for all our learners. Children in the Early Years Foundation Stage are taught using the EYFS framework with an emphasis on developing key skills, knowledge and understanding through direct teaching and structured continuous provision. Our curriculum is designed with knowledge at its heart to ensure that children develop a strong vocabulary base and understanding of the world. The curriculum promotes long-term learning and we believe that progress means knowing more and remembering more. We have developed a curriculum built on current research regarding how memory works to ensure that children not only have access to 'the best that has been thought and said' but are taught this in a way that ensures children can remember the curriculum content in future years.

pageCache.pageTitle: St Andrew's C of E Primary School - Welcome from the Headteacher
pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Headteacher
I am pleased to extend to you a warm welcome to St Andrew’s Church of England Primary school. Our school is a very special place to be. We are a family where our pupils thrive, love learning and develop the skills to be able to enjoy “Life in all its fullness”.
We are very proud of our inspiring and ambitious curriculum. This is enhanced by our broad range of trips, visits, enrichment opportunities and our after-school clubs.
Our pupils thrive and benefit from great teaching across the school. We have a happy, welcoming team of staff who are all committed to be the best they can be.
Our 6 core values create a culture and ethos of high expectations and standards. We believe that all of our pupils can achieve great things, and we ensure that we prepare them for every stage of their school life.
Our pupils are at the heart of all that we do. We have a commitment to know each child and their family, working in partnership to achieve the best for each pupil. We have a dedicated team of professionals who support the pastoral and well-being needs of our pupils.
We have amazing grounds. Pupils play and take part in a wide range of competitive and non-competitive sports across our 10 acres of space, with three playgrounds, space for six football pitches, an outdoor learning space, a pond and playing fields with plenty of space. At playtimes pupils develop their resilience, creativity, collaborative skills and imagination through the OPAL scheme. We have Forest Schools provision and pupils enjoy accessing our music, cookery and art rooms.
We are a community school enjoying close links and opening our doors to our school church, Reed’s, ACS and other groups. St Andrew’s is part of the Enlighten Learning Trust which has enabled us to develop purposeful and mutually supportive links with other schools.
